title: Open-extended injectives are proper-direct-image acyclic on pro-etale sites
statement:
Let $p:B\to D$ and $r:C\to E$ be proper morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-proper-morphism], and let $k:C\hookrightarrow B$ and $i:E\hookrightarrow D$ be quasi-compact open immersions [def-weil-open-immersion, def-weil-finite-type-morphism] with $p\circ k=i\circ r$. The square is not required to be cartesian. Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and use constant-$A$ module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every injective object $J$ of $\operatorname{Mod}(A_C)$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], its extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero] is $p_*$-acyclic:
$$R^q p_*(k_!J)=0\qquad(q>0).$$
Here $R^qp_*$ means $\mathcal H^q(Rp_*(-[0]))$ for the ordinary uncompleted derived direct image [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. There is no etale-origin hypothesis on $J$.
